text:
sam: Quick heads-up — ran an inventory cross-check and found a mismatch for reservation 8401 (us-west). Procurement’s delivery notes say 4 H100 nodes arrived, but our rack manifest shows 0 allocated. Can infra pick this up? :thinking:

ana: On it. I’ll ping procurement and the rack team. tagging @tariq for cable/mapping verification.

tariq: I can grab this in the next 30m. Which rack/PDUs? I see a partial manifest entry under RACK-17 but it’s missing serials.

sam: RACK-17 is the expected placement per the PO. Procurement note attached: https://procurement.ops/po/8401 — lists serials S-H100-115..118.

liz: Heads-up from runtime side — hold canary turn-up for any nodes tied to 8401 until we confirm. We had a latency blip last week and don’t want flaky hosts in the pool.

megan: Also double-check reservation quotas for dedicated customers — if those 4 are currently unallocated we may need to move capacity reservations to avoid customer impact.

ana: Procurement confirms delivery scanned on 2026-02-08 03:12 UTC. They provided crate IDs but no rack install timestamp. I’m asking shipping team for handoff photos.

infra-bot: Manifest update event — reservation 8401 -> status: pending-attach (source: procurement). link: https://infra-logs/8401

tariq: Quick check logs from the rack install script:```
inventoryctl get-reservation 8401 --format=json
# result: nodes: [] ; rack: RACK-17; pdu-mapped: false
```

tariq: Looks like nodes were staged but not racked/powered. No cable mapping done. I’ll physically verify cabling today and update the manifest.

sam: Thanks. Ana, can you update the reservation ticket with procurement ETA for install photos and set a blocker for canary?

ana: Done — ticket #INFRA-1187 updated, added procurement ETA and photo request. Also added a note: prioritize serial reconciliation before any host joins production pools.

liz: Appreciate it. I’ve put a temporary hold on the canary pipeline for that region (pipeline: canary-us-west-h100). If nodes appear staged but not powered we’ll skip them. :thumbsup:

megan: For capacity planning: if those 4 nodes are delayed >48h we should flip an aux reservation from the reserved pool to cover incoming customer commitments. Who owns that decision?

sam: Ops lead makes the reserve flip; @megan please escalate to ops and cc product if ETA slips past 48h.

ana: Procurement sent preliminary install window for tomorrow 09:00–12:00 PT. I’ll push for earlier if possible.

tariq: I’ll validate physical install by 11:30 PT and push serials into inventoryctl. If I see any failure I’ll mark nodes as quarantined and post logs.

infra-bot: Reservation 8401 annotation added by tariq at 2678902980: "staged-not-racked"

sam: Plan summary: 1) Tariq verifies rack/cabling and pushes serials by 11:30 PT. 2) Ana collects install proof and updates INFRA-1187. 3) Liz holds canary until inventory shows powered-in nodes. 4) Megan/ops to prepare aux-reserve plan if >48h delay.

tariq: A couple of quick asks: can someone confirm PDU A for RACK-17 is on the maintenance blacklist? I don’t want automated power cycles during staging.

ana: Confirmed — PDU A is in maintenance mode until provisioning completes. I toggled the annotation on the manifest.

sam: Perfect. If all good we’ll target a staggered canary at +2 hours after serial ingestion to give time for kernel/drivers smoke tests.

liz: Sounds good. I’ll schedule the canary window but will only enable once I see the inventory event.

megan: I’ll prep a short ops runbook for the aux-reserve flip (steps, owners, rollback) and post to the thread by EOD.

sam: Excellent. Thanks all — please post small updates here so we can close the loop. :raised_hands:
